paragraphs: Brickfield Education Labs sells digital accessibility tools for education, training and live events. Buyers range from universities and further-education colleges to government departments, state bodies, international training centres, companies and membership bodies.

There are two main products, one for a whole Moodle site and one for editor-level checking on any platform using TinyMCE at a lower entry price. The Moodle toolkit does site-wide accessibility auditing and reporting. The editor checker runs 96 accessibility checks across 20 categories as authors write. It is listed at 995 euro per site, per year. Both follow the same find, fix and futureproof sequence, so that accessibility becomes routine rather than a one-off project. A separate product does real-time speech-to-text with multi-language translation for conferences, lectures and live events. A conversion service turns course documents into audio, ePub, electronic Braille, Word, HTML and tagged PDF.

The company says the toolkit is certified by Moodle HQ. The work is aligned to WCAG 2.2 Level AA. It reports use at universities ranging from 500 to more than 250,000 students. Alongside the software it offers instructor-led workshops and self-paced academy courses.
